图为我国某省能源基地图。<image1>
该省正在建设我国最大的炼铝厂。从能源条件看，其布局考虑的主导因素是什么？
raw_record.answer: This province has abundant energy resources and low prices

When arranging its layout, priority will be given to whether electricity and energy supply are sufficient and whether the cost is low. The figure emphasizes that this province is an energy base, indicating that its energy resources are abundant. Therefore, from the perspective of energy conditions, the dominant factor is abundant energy resources and low prices.
